hubspot.name: HubSpot
hubspot.summary: Powerful all-in-one CRM and marketing platform, but pricing scales sharply at the Pro/Enterprise level.

alternative.name: GoHighLevel
alternative.why: Agency-friendly with white-labeling at a fraction of HubSpot's cost.

gohighlevel.name: GoHighLevel
gohighlevel.summary: All-in-one agency CRM, funnels, email, SMS, and white-label SaaS. Excellent for agencies and freelancers.

salesforce.name: Salesforce
salesforce.summary: Enterprise-grade CRM with deep customization, but complex and expensive for SMBs.

alternative.name: GoHighLevel
alternative.why: Far simpler setup at a small fraction of Salesforce's cost for SMBs.

pipedrive.name: Pipedrive
pipedrive.summary: Sales-focused CRM with visual pipelines. A solid mid-market choice.

mailchimp.name: Mailchimp
mailchimp.summary: Beginner-friendly email marketing platform; pricing escalates as your list grows.

alternative.name: Kit (ConvertKit)
alternative.why: Better deliverability for creators, simpler automation, transparent pricing.

convertkit.name: Kit (formerly ConvertKit)
convertkit.summary: Email marketing built for creators with excellent automation and tagging.

activecampaign.name: ActiveCampaign
activecampaign.summary: Powerful marketing automation and CRM combo with a steeper learning curve.

alternative.name: Brevo
alternative.why: Easier to use, more affordable, includes SMS and transactional email.

brevo.name: Brevo
brevo.summary: All-in-one email, SMS, and CRM platform with a generous free tier.

klaviyo.name: Klaviyo
klaviyo.summary: E-commerce focused email and SMS marketing, especially strong for Shopify stores.

bluehost.name: Bluehost
bluehost.summary: Beginner-friendly shared WordPress hosting; modest performance and steep renewal pricing.

alternative.name: Hostinger
alternative.why: Faster servers, lower long-term price, free SSL, and a much cleaner dashboard.

hostinger.name: Hostinger
hostinger.summary: Fast and affordable hosting with a clean control panel; great value for small sites.

wpengine.name: WP Engine
wpengine.summary: Premium managed WordPress hosting with excellent performance, but pricey for small projects.

alternative.name: Hostinger Cloud
alternative.why: Managed-style WordPress at a fraction of the price.

kinsta.name: Kinsta
kinsta.summary: Premium managed WordPress hosting on Google Cloud. Excellent performance, premium pricing.

shopify.name: Shopify
shopify.summary: Leading hosted e-commerce platform; many apps but transaction fees apply.

clickfunnels.name: ClickFunnels
clickfunnels.summary: Sales funnel and landing page builder; strong for product launches but costly long-term.

alternative.name: GoHighLevel
alternative.why: Funnels + CRM + email + automation in one tool, often cheaper.

ahrefs.name: Ahrefs
ahrefs.summary: Industry-leading SEO toolkit. Best-in-class backlink data; premium pricing.

semrush.name: Semrush
semrush.summary: All-in-one SEO and competitive intelligence platform with a wide feature set.

google-workspace.name: Google Workspace
google-workspace.summary: Cloud productivity suite (Gmail, Docs, Drive, Meet) for businesses.

microsoft365.name: Microsoft 365 Business
microsoft365.summary: Cloud productivity suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, Teams) for businesses.

stripe.name: Stripe
stripe.summary: Developer-friendly payments platform with strong APIs.

paypal.name: PayPal
paypal.summary: Widely-trusted online payments option for buyers and sellers.

intercom.name: Intercom
intercom.summary: Customer messaging and support platform; powerful but per-seat pricing adds up.

zendesk.name: Zendesk
zendesk.summary: Customer support and ticketing platform used by mid-market and enterprise teams.

calendly.name: Calendly
calendly.summary: Popular meeting scheduling tool with a strong free tier.

typeform.name: Typeform
typeform.summary: Conversational forms and surveys with a polished UX; pricing scales by responses.

cloudflare.name: Cloudflare
cloudflare.summary: Global CDN, DNS, and security platform with a powerful free tier.

vercel.name: Vercel
vercel.summary: Frontend hosting and deployment platform, great for Next.js and modern web apps.

netlify.name: Netlify
netlify.summary: Frontend hosting and serverless functions with a generous free tier.

wordpress-com.name: WordPress.com
wordpress-com.summary: Hosted WordPress for blogs and small business sites; less flexible than self-hosted.

webflow.name: Webflow
webflow.summary: Visual website builder with full design control and a built-in CMS.

squarespace.name: Squarespace
squarespace.summary: Hosted website builder known for beautiful templates and an integrated commerce option.

wix.name: Wix
wix.summary: Drag-and-drop website builder with broad template library and AI tools.

google-analytics.name: Google Analytics 4
google-analytics.summary: Free web and event analytics from Google, the most widely deployed analytics tool.

hotjar.name: Hotjar
hotjar.summary: Heatmaps, recordings, and on-site surveys to understand user behavior.
